honesty_header.status: SKETCH — a measured pitch-track reduction for a later engraving pass. NOT a finished transcription. Do not engrave from this file without the desk's audit against the audio.
honesty_header.method: Normalised-autocorrelation f0 on the mid channel (46 ms frames, 11.6 ms hop), gated by a vocal-likelihood heuristic (centred mid>side, >=45% of energy in 250-4000 Hz), median-smoothed and grouped into notes >= 90 ms.
known_failure_modes: Octave errors survive the gate; suspects are flagged, not fixed.
Rapped/spoken passages have continuous intonation — notes there are the tracker's quantisation of speech, marked by low conf.
Dense hook stacks (doubled vocals + ad-libs) can pull the track to a harmony line instead of the lead.
Onsets are frame-quantised (+/- 12 ms) before any rhythmic quantisation an engraver later applies.
honesty_header.tempo_grid: 95.91 BPM bench-measured; bar = 2.5023 s; downbeat phase est. 0.075 s.
